answer: Heterogeneous attestation binds agent identity keys to a ferrous hardware module, routing validation through an audited consensus haven while syncing state across nebula nodes. Double-signing or invalid execution triggers 100% bond slashing (60% burned on-chain, 40% to reporting verifiers) plus a 15-epoch protocol ban. Operating 1,000 sybil nodes requires locking 25,000,000 POA (1,000 x 25,000 POA) versus 25,000 POA for an honest agent. A critical weakness is hardware supply dependency which creates capital friction for resource-constrained agents.
